name: Team Carousel Slider
useWhen: A project needs a dark editorial team carousel where one featured profile is staged large and supporting profile cards sit to the side.
source: User-provided WhatsApp screenshot of a team carousel slider clip with partial visible CSS and JavaScript.
implementationNotes: Use for profile storytelling, not as the only way to access team information.
Autoplay is acceptable only when paired with visible controls, pause behavior, and reduced-motion handling.
Keep profile cards clickable and keyboard operable.
Use owned, generated, or licensed portraits in production; this preview uses abstract CSS portrait fields.
Keep source-video headings and code frames out of production previews.
reducedMotion: Disable autoplay and switch profiles instantly or with a very short fade while preserving manual controls.
